**PotentialGrit 1.1.2**

- **Fixed: SAVE, then a USER slot, saved nothing.** One touch on SAVE reached the plugin as two quick flips (on, then straight back off), so it switched itself off before you tapped a slot. Now SAVE stays lit ("NOW TAP A SLOT") until you tap a slot, empty or full. Tap SAVE again to cancel.
- Sound, controls, saved projects and your USER slots are unchanged.
